finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

`TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')` came from [src/core/options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7). The bundler renamed `retries` to `retryCount`. It now takes either.

[src/net/retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on an unset flag. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`. Unset now means off.

The 8 warnings are real deprecations. `Buffer()`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher` and more. Worth a separate pass.
